prompt: A cat sanctuary run by a grumpy old librarian.

card.name: Whisker Hollow Cat Sanctuary

site.text: A small, cozy village-style compound on gentle existing land, within the 64-block claim, with garden courtyards for cats to roam.

style.text: Cozy, bookish and slightly crotchety: warm wood, shelves, lanterns, wool carpets, cat-sized nooks and perches.

purpose.text: A cat sanctuary that shelters and feeds strays, run by a grumpy old librarian who also keeps a library.

card.interpretation: I read this as a small, cozy village-style sanctuary in a rustic bookish style, centred on the librarian's library-home with cat dorms, a feeding hall, a garden, a sick bay and a fish shed. Size is M, with medium density. Terrain is existing land. The grumpiness shows in signs and details only.
assumptions: Rustic style chosen to fit a cozy bookish mood.
No backstory given, so none invented.
Fish shed placed by water if any is near.

program.notes: Tall bookshelves, lectern, reading nooks, a grumpy sign or two; the librarian's bed upstairs; cats sleeping on shelves.
Rows of cat beds, wool carpets, window perches and cat doors via trapdoors.
Fish troughs (cauldrons/barrels), food stores, water bowls.
Fenced yard with climbing trees, hay bales, flowers, scratching posts, fish pond.
Quiet infirmary with brewing stand, beds and curtains.
Fishing supplies and smoked fish for feeding the cats.
Entry arch with 'No Dogs' sign and adoption desk.
